extension.description: Annual net earnings show how much take-home pay an average worker receives in a year. They are calculated by subtracting income tax and the worker’s social security contributions from gross pay, and by adding family allowances when relevant. The data show how gross pay becomes net pay in different example family and income situations, and are presented in euro, national currencies and purchasing power standards.
